intro.title: 3 years at Vantage — industrial crusher monitoring platform
intro.description: I built the Patriot and VSI dashboards from scratch: WebSocket with multiple states per equipment, layout adapted from the operator's phone to the control room monitor, auth with JWT decoding and routing by user type. When the data came in wrong, machines stopped — that shaped how I think about interfaces.

philosophy.title: How I work
philosophy.description: Typed contracts between layers, file conventions the team follows without asking me, and tests on the paths that actually matter — not to hit a number.

vantage.title: Vantage · 2021–2024
vantage.role: Front-end Engineer — industrial crusher monitoring platform
vantage.summary: Patriot (cone crusher) and VSI dashboards built from scratch. Data arriving via Socket.io every 10 seconds, alerts based on readStatus and edgeStatus, and a complete responsiveness refactor so operators could use it on their phones in the field.

items.dashboards: Patriot and VSI dashboards — hydraulics, lubrication, motor status, vibration, cavity level. Schema-based equipment detection (SchemaType). GPS with three fallback levels: live coordinates → static equipment location → no pin.
items.realtime: Promise.allSettled to load equipment unit, latest data, and socket in parallel. When a machine stopped, the UI communicated it immediately through readStatus and edgeStatus — not just a visual indicator, a data contract.
items.responsive: Full responsiveness refactor from zero: useBreakpoint hook with xs/sm/md/lg/xl. Five intentional layouts for Patriot alone — modules reordered, columns collapsed, panels stacked for field use.
items.auth: JWT decoded with jwtDecode, user extracted from payload, routing by UserType (admin / service / customer). RegisterPassword validates the token in the backend before showing the form and auto-logs in after creation.

education.title: Education
education.complementary: Ongoing specialization on Udemy, RocketSeat and Alura. Over 400 certified hours in React, TypeScript, automated testing and backend with Python.

skills.title: Capabilities
skills.subtitle: 3 years writing front-end where a UI failure means machines stop and operators lose visibility. Industrial dashboards, full auth flow, and responsiveness rebuilt from scratch.

experience.title: Front-end in production
experience.intro: Industrial dashboards over bidirectional WebSocket — per-equipment state mapping, alerts based on readStatus and edgeStatus, and responsive layout with useBreakpoint for field use. From component library down to Playwright on the critical paths.
experience.subtitle: Industrial monitoring, admin panels, and this portfolio.

auth.title: JWT auth with role-based routing
auth.description: Login with JWT decoding via jwtDecode, user extraction from the token payload, and automatic redirect by UserType — admin, service, and customer on separate routes.
auth.highlight: RegisterPassword validates the token against the backend before showing the form, then performs auto-login after password creation.

state.highlight: Session, preferences, and layout stores wired to the request layer.

realtime.title: Industrial dashboards with WebSocket
realtime.description: Socket.io at Vantage for Patriot and VSI crusher monitoring — per-equipment states, alerts based on readStatus and edgeStatus, reconnection with listener cleanup on unmount.
realtime.highlight: Promise.allSettled to load equipment unit, latest data, and socket in parallel — graceful degradation if any request fails.

theming.title: Design Systems
theming.description: Styled-components with semantic tokens, dark/light mode, zero inline styles — architecture that scales without losing consistency.
theming.highlight: .tsx + .style.ts separation by convention; Ant Design integrated to the theme without CSS overrides.

dashboards.title: Patriot and VSI dashboards
dashboards.description: Crusher monitoring screens for cone crusher (Patriot) and VSI — each with its own modules, schema-based detection (SchemaType), and data arriving via WebSocket every 10 seconds.
dashboards.highlight: GPS with multiple fallbacks: latestUnitData → static equipment coordinates → no pin.

architecture.highlight: Patriot with columns and modules reordered across xs/sm/md/lg/xl — each breakpoint with an intentional layout.
